discovery_only_primary_research_lead.paper_title: Stablecoins on Unstable Venues: A MiCA Depeg Episode
discovery_only_primary_research_lead.role: novelty and future-event mechanism lead only; no discovery value is used as a current price, cost, access, capacity, or profit input

limitations: The issuer source proves a legal at-par redemption identity, not retail or repository-account access, onboarding, eligibility, limits, fees, transfer support, timing, completion, or operational continuity.
The retained Binance books are a 60-observation historical current-state population from 2026-08-29 and do not prove a future spread.
All 60 retained top-of-book observations were identical, so the sample supplies zero quote-change evidence despite 3,675 reported 24-hour trades.

Blockchain transfer, Binance withdrawal, issuer redemption, bank receipt, delay, failure, tax, custody, compliance, account, infrastructure, and alternative-yield costs are all unproved and credited as adverse rather than zero.
No new capital, EURI acquisition, redemption, transfer, issuer application, Binance order, or account action is authorized.

retry_policy.do_not_repeat: Do not repeat the official issuer page or the exact retained 60-book population and do not poll EUREURI for a one-bip spread.
retry_policy.literal_trigger: Reopen only after a material official issuer redemption access fee timing or continuity change, a material Binance EURI listing fee or venue-access change, or an independently observed event-driven EUREURI discount above 25 bips from a source that is not repeated venue polling; then freeze one finite-size current book and require exact account fee plus issuer-access and full redemption-cost evidence before any state-changing authority.
